text: This code is a straightforward and efficient implementation of the Fibonacci sequence using recursion. By defining the base cases for n = 0 and n = 1, the function correctly returns 0 and 1, respectively. For n > 1, the function recursively calls itself with the arguments n - 1 and n - 2, effectively calculating the nth Fibonacci number as the sum of the two preceding numbers. This approach is a classic example of a recursive solution to the Fibonacci problem, and it accurately produces the correct result for any non-negative integer n.
